The app uses grid-search initialization to help each nonlinear model start fitting from reasonable parameter values. It tries many candidate starting-value sets within the configured bounds and uses the best-performing candidate to start the final curve fit.

This step reduces the need for manual parameter tuning and can make fitting more stable, but it is not itself the final fitting algorithm and does not guarantee that the final fitted parameters are the global optimum.
